facebook.text:
3 questions to answer before you write a single word of your 2027 marketing plan.

Most plans start with tactics — platforms, posting schedules, ad budgets. That's backwards. Before any of that, you need clarity on three things:

1) Who are we actually trying to reach?
2) What one thing do we want them to do?
3) What does success look like in plain language?

These aren't extra work. They're the pre-work that makes everything else faster and sharper. Skip them and you'll spend next year busy but directionless.
